# Staff Notifications Checklist: Choose which messages I get as a garage, mechanic or admin

**Purpose**: Requirements quality for staff notification settings: API (read and save), send-time check, web panel.
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: standard. Audience: PR reviewer. Focus: API contract and send-time rules, then panel. A struck item (`~~...~~`) does not apply; the reason follows it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the types listed for every staff role (owner, receptionist, mechanic with and without `can_answer_quotes`, admin) enumerated rather than implied? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK002 Is the entry for a person who is staff of several garages, or staff and admin, defined? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-001]
- [x] CHK003 Is every refusal of a save mapped to a status and a code? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK004 Are the states of the panel (loading, loaded, read failed, save failed, WhatsApp unavailable, locked, no outside channel) each given a required behaviour and text? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012–FR-014]
- [x] CHK005 Is the live refresh of the panel specified for both triggering events? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK006 Is the audit and transaction behaviour of a staff save stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK007 Are accessibility requirements for the switches stated (name, label)? [Gap, Spec §FR-012] (fixed: FR-012 now names a visible label and an accessible name)
- [x] CHK008 Is the result of a rapid second toggle while a save is pending defined? [Gap, Edge Case] (fixed: plan Web §3 states that the last answer replaces the state)
- [x] ~~CHK009 Are requirements stated for a person who is both GarageMember and Mechanic of one garage? [Gap, Edge Case]~~ Struck: not in the brief; FR-001 already gives one entry per membership and per mechanic row, and Principle I forbids new scope.
- [x] ~~CHK010 Is a latency target stated for `GET`? [Gap, Non-Functional]~~ Struck: no target in the story or ST-197; the plan's Performance Goals bound the reads and nothing else is asked.
- [x] ~~CHK011 Are authentication requirements stated for the routes? [Gap, Security]~~ Struck: the app-wide `ActorGuard` (AGENTS.md) covers every route and ST-197 owns them; FR-008 covers authorization.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK012 Is "locked" defined unambiguously, per channel, with the full list of types? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK013 Is `enabled` for a channel with no saved row defined, including the WhatsApp exception? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK014 Is `enabled` for a locked channel defined when a saved row says off? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003] (fixed: FR-003 now says a locked channel always reads enabled)
- [x] CHK015 Is "the state the whole save leaves" for the at-least-one rule defined precisely? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK016 Is the difference between a driver row and a staff row stated as a testable rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK017 Is the order of WhatsApp reasons stated when both apply? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Assumptions]

- [x] CHK018 Do the receptionist list in Story 2 and the owner-only list in FR-004 name the same eleven types? [Consistency, Spec §US2.1, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK019 Do the type counts and sections in the plan (37 types) match FR-005? [Consistency, Plan §Scale/Scope, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK020 Do the always-sent locks in FR-006 agree with Story 1 scenario 4 and the DOCUMENT_* change in scenario 5 and FR-010? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK021 Does the 422/400 split for `channel_not_allowed` read the same in FR-008 and the Assumptions? [Conflict check, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK022 Do the spec's panel texts and the plan's i18n keys cover the same lines? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-014, Plan §Web 4]
